the two mutation-shaped invariants (return-period and duration monotonicity) were validated on 9 covered points x 190 cells on 2026-09-18; they are a physical law, not a payload guarantee, so they are the guardrail that would fire first if NOAA reordered the matrix — but that specific event has not been observed, so the guardrail has been shown to fire only on synthetic reorderings.
